prompt: give me an itinerary for a day in paris on june 11th saturday from 12pm to 10pm. no museums or other things that take too long. include lunch and dinner (vegan options preferred)
response:
Certainly! Here's a fun and engaging itinerary for a day in Paris on June 11th, Saturday, from 12 PM to 10 PM, with a focus on outdoor activities and vegan dining options:

### 12:00 PM - 1:00 PM: Lunch at Le Potager du Marais
Start your day with a delicious vegan lunch at Le Potager du Marais, located in the trendy Marais district. This cozy café offers a variety of vegan dishes, including salads, sandwiches, and bowls. The atmosphere is relaxed and perfect for a leisurely start to your day.

### 1:30 PM - 3:30 PM: Stroll Through the Marais
After lunch, take a leisurely walk through the Marais district. Explore the charming streets, visit the Place des Vosges, and admire the historic architecture. This area is rich in history and culture, and you can easily spend a couple of hours wandering around.

### 3:30 PM - 4:30 PM: Visit the Picasso Museum (Quick Tour)
While you mentioned avoiding long visits to museums, a quick tour of the Picasso Museum can be a great way to see some of Picasso's works without spending too much time. The museum is compact and you can get a good sense of Picasso's art in a short period.

### 4:30 PM - 6:00 PM: Explore the Latin Quarter
Head over to the Latin Quarter, another vibrant area of Paris. This neighborhood is known for its lively atmosphere, especially in the evening. You can visit the Panthéon, the Jardin du Luxembourg, or simply enjoy the ambiance of the streets.

### 6:00 PM - 7:00 PM: Vegan Dinner at Le Potager du Marais (Again)
If you enjoyed your lunch, you might want to return to Le Potager du Marais for dinner. They offer a variety of vegan options that are both delicious and satisfying. Alternatively, you could try another vegan-friendly restaurant in the area, such as Le Grenier de Notre-Dame.

### 7:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Seine River Cruise
End your day with a relaxing Seine River cruise. There are several companies that offer short cruises, which are a great way to see Paris from a different perspective. The evening cruise will give you a beautiful view of the illuminated city, including the Eiffel Tower, Notre-Dame, and other iconic landmarks.

### 9:30 PM - 10:00 PM: Return to Your Accommodation
After the cruise, you can either walk back to your accommodation or take a short taxi ride. Enjoy the last moments of your day in Paris, perhaps reflecting on the beautiful sights and experiences you've had.

This itinerary balances outdoor exploration, cultural experiences, and delicious vegan dining, all while keeping your time in Paris dynamic and engaging. Enjoy your day in the City of Light!
